description: 12-1 momentum remains predictive after beta control
economic_rationale: Momentum should not be only a high-beta proxy
outcome_note: Positive controlled coefficients in both samples; confirmation family-level evidence is not decisive.

description: 12-1 momentum remains predictive after sector neutralization
economic_rationale: Within-sector continuation is less likely to be a sector rotation artifact
outcome_note: Sector-neutral momentum survives family FDR in development and confirmation.

description: 12-1 momentum remains predictive after beta volatility and sector controls
economic_rationale: Momentum should carry information beyond observable risk exposures
signal_definition: momentum_12_1 controlling beta_20 realized_vol_20 and sector
outcome_note: Full-control momentum is positive in development but fails confirmation inference.

description: A broad momentum effect appears in predefined 6-1 9-1 12-1 and 12-2 definitions
economic_rationale: Continuation should not depend on one exact lookback
outcome_note: Definitions have broadly positive signs but no variant survives family FDR in confirmation.

economic_rationale: Risk scaling may distinguish persistent trends from volatile jumps
outcome_note: Risk scaling does not improve development evidence or confirmation robustness.

description: Realized volatility remains predictive after beta control
economic_rationale: The volatility effect may contain information beyond systematic market exposure
outcome_note: Volatility stays positive after beta control, but residualized rank evidence fails confirmation.

description: Realized volatility remains predictive after beta momentum and sector controls
economic_rationale: An independent effect should survive major observable confounds
signal_definition: realized_vol_20 controlling beta_20 momentum_12_1 and sector
outcome_note: Sector/full-control coefficients are positive but development and confirmation evidence conflict.

description: Idiosyncratic volatility predicts future cross-sectional returns
economic_rationale: Security-specific rather than market volatility may explain the effect
outcome_note: Idiosyncratic volatility is significant in development and fails confirmation.

description: One-day reversal is stronger in the predefined high-market-volatility regime
economic_rationale: Phase 3 suggested liquidity provision effects intensify in volatile markets
outcome_note: High-volatility reversal is strong in development and absent in confirmation.

description: One-day reversal is concentrated in predefined 5 10 and 20 percent tails
economic_rationale: Behavioral overreaction should be strongest after extreme moves
outcome_note: Only the most extreme 5% tail retains a modest confirmation spread.

description: An equal-weight momentum and beta-residualized volatility combination improves stability
economic_rationale: Complementary independent information may reinforce ranking
signal_definition: 0.5 momentum z plus 0.5 residualized volatility z
outcome_note: Momentum plus beta-residualized volatility is positive, monotonic, and long-only useful in confirmation; family q narrowly misses 5%.

description: A predefined conditional reversal component complements momentum in high volatility
economic_rationale: Reversal is regime-dependent while momentum is comparatively stable
signal_definition: momentum z plus 0.25 reversal z only in high-volatility regime
outcome_note: Conditional reversal does not improve confirmation IC over momentum alone.

description: Short-term reversal differs between overnight and intraday components
economic_rationale: Overnight information and intraday liquidity effects may have different persistence
outcome_note: Intraday reversal is strong only in development; neither component confirms.
